user.title: Set up Energy Cost Monitor
user.description: Choose guided to select sensors without code. Advanced is an optional import. Use this development version in a lab.

reconfigure.title: Correct configuration
reconfigure.description: Existing measurements are retained. Source identities, units, thresholds and maximum report gap must match the ledger; changing them requires a future migration.

advanced.title: Advanced source import
advanced.description: Optional JSON entry. Use guided setup for ordinary installation. Existing stores are never replaced.

sources.title: Choose optional measurements
sources.description: House consumption and grid import are required. Select only additional measurements you have. Required energy meters for selected capabilities are added automatically.

source.title: Configure source: {role}
source.description: Choose the sensor, measurement type and actual unit. Cumulative is a total counter; daily is a daily estimate. The power limit checks plausible increments, not device control. Use companion freshness signals only when they reliably prove meter freshness.

review.title: Review selected sources
review.description:
{sources}

Save stores these settings; restart repeats selection. Sharing house/import requires identical settings and no solar, battery or export.

error.invalid_configuration: Invalid source configuration, incompatible existing ledger, or polling interval outside source freshness limits. Correct the settings; the ledger has not been replaced.
error.storage_unavailable: Cannot access the existing ledger. Check storage access and retry.
error.invalid_source: Check the sensor, unit and positive limits. The unit must match the sensor unit.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Energy Cost Monitor instance is supported.
abort.already_configured: Energy Cost Monitor is already configured.

init.title: Collection interval
init.description: Polling reads existing HA states. It does not request device updates. This interval must not exceed any configured freshness limit or the maximum report gap.

error.invalid_poll_interval: Use an integer from 5 to 300 seconds, no longer than source freshness or maximum report gap.
